benchmark.rule: Both markets are graded against a frozen benchmark computed from weeks strictly before the game: the home side is spotted the home-field constant, and the total line is the prior-week league mean doubled. M00 forecasts exactly 0.5 on both, so M00 is the coin-flip control and Brier skill is measured against it.
benchmark.side_line: home -2.0 (a cover needs the home side to win by more than 2)
benchmark.total_line: 2 x prior-week league points per team-game, rounded to the nearest half point

models.name: Null: league mean and home field
